title: Android: better format for tumblr
summary: long reblog chains for tumblr posts are unreadable on mobile because of the nested blockquotes. this isn’t your fault, but they’re definitely not going to fix it. in my ideal world you’d automatically rewrite them to un-nest the blockquotes, but i don’t know how you feel about silently modifying the items. or how i’d feel about it if you did it to feeds i hadn’t explicitly requested, for that matter. so failing that, css that doesn’t make the quoted text one character per line would be great. ...
body_markdown:
long reblog chains for tumblr posts are unreadable on mobile because of the nested blockquotes. this isn’t your fault, but they’re definitely not going to fix it. in my ideal world you’d automatically rewrite them to un-nest the blockquotes, but i don’t know how you feel about silently modifying the items. or how i’d feel about it if you did it to feeds i hadn’t explicitly requested, for that matter. so failing that, css that doesn’t make the quoted text one character per line would be great.
